title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1564: Help is useless (2)

section.p: Wisdom King was truly strong.
He was facing six death sovereigns alone. Four were seventh-degree Eternals and two were sixth-degree Eternals. Even so, he was the one pushing his opponents back.
The two weaker death sovereigns looked rather miserable as even their death qi was starting to leak due to his attacks. He was too strong.
Su Yu had a feeling Wisdom King was probably comparable to Great Qin King in strength.

Back in the mansion, Great Qin King had also faced numerous Invincibles alone. Then again, that fight had happened in the Luminous Domain Mansion, not the Death Realm. And at the time, there were only two late-degree Eternals among Great Qin King’s opponents.
“What a powerful guy.”
Even if this guy might be weaker than Great Qin King, he would most certainly be slightly stronger than Blood Fire. Truly worthy of being an expert from the first epoch.
“Trying to run?”

Su Yu noted that Wisdom King was slowly heading toward the tunnel connected with the ancient city. That tunnel was quite conspicuous, visible even this far away. Thus, Su Yu decided to forget about the other Invincibles. With over thirty death sovereigns here, none of them would survive.
Wisdom King was the sole person with a chance to escape.
Just as Su Yu was about to move away, someone shouted, “Su Yu! Save me! I’m a human! A human!”
An expert with a golden mask was yelling miserably. He was the Earth Department head.
A human?
The head removed his mask and hurriedly said, “I’m a human! A human from the ninth epoch! A human—”
“No, you’re not.” Su Yu said coldly, “How are you a human? If you were human, you would have acted when the West Spire head acted. Why are you suddenly a human now?”
A human?
Forget it.
This wasn’t even someone he knew. Even if this was someone he knew, he wouldn’t show mercy to someone who had stood against him all along.

The Earth Department head begged in desperation, “Su Yu, you don’t understand! I had no choice! Heavenly Overseer Marquis is too strong! I was planning to keep waiting for a better opportunity to act. I’m telling the truth, Su Yu! Spare me!”
Su Yu hesitated slightly before flying over. As he flew, he said, “Don’t move. I can’t control the sovereigns. Approach me. I’ll take you away…”

The Earth Department head roared and used all his strength to flee toward Su Yu. As he fled, he pushed he death sovereigns around him aside with his saber. He hesitated slightly as he neared Su Yu, but he had no choice but to keep moving forward.
Eventually, he was only a hundred meters away from Su Yu. Abruptly, Su Yu flickered and closed the gap between them before throwing a punch.
A head burst apart.

Then, the Mark of Civilization appeared. With an indifferent expression, Su Yu collected the corpse. Looking at the approaching death sovereigns, he smiled and said, “No rush. He can die two more times. This is a nice guy. He has three corpses to offer since he can die three times in total. I’ll take one. You can have the rest.”
Understanding dawned on the two death sovereigns. So that was the split.
Right after returning in his second body, the Earth Department head wailed, “Su Yu! You tricked me!”
Su Yu shrugged and said without looking back, “Nope. I’ll take that body of yours back to the world of the living. Don’t worry. I’ll keep my word.”
A human?
Heh.
Su Yu couldn’t even be bothered to say more. He would have left the department head alone not knowing that. But knowing that, he naturally needed to give the department head a punch as well.
The desperate howls of the department head rang out repeatedly. He couldn’t accept this. Alas, the death spirits did not care about his indignation. Su Yu didn’t care either. He could only die.
Su Yu couldn’t understand the logic behind the department head’s plea for mercy. It wasn’t like Su Yu had never killed a human before.

Su Yu returned his focus to Wisdom King, thinking of consuming Wisdom King with his Mark of Civilization. Ignoring the fact that his book would probably grow a lot stronger, Wisdom King’s age alone made him worth consuming. As someone who had lived from the first epoch, he definitely knew a lot of secrets.

People like He Tu were unreliable as they were already dead. As death sovereigns, they didn’t even have their complete memories anymore. Thus, Wisdom King could probably provide a lot of new information. This could be a very profitable kill.

Furthermore, killing Wisdom King might even produce more heavenly rewards. This would be the best opportunity for Su Yu to further strengthen his characters. He wanted to push all his characters to the Sunmoon Realm.
Su Yu started approaching Wisdom King.
At this point, Wisdom King was already bloodied, with numerous wounds on his body. However, he continued fighting silently.

Abruptly, Su Yu threw a punch. Living up to his reputation, Wisdom King was able to react against that and send Su Yu flying with a palm attack. However, the punch did manage to leave a hole on Wisdom King’s palm while his entire body trembled from the impact.

His eyes remained cold, but he was greatly shocked inwardly. What a powerful offensive strength. In the damnable Death Realm, even his control over the power of time was slightly weakened. That, combined with the death sovereigns he was facing, had forced him to take Su Yu’s attack head-on instead of dodging.
Su Yu rushed forth once again and threw another attack.
Leaving?
Dream on!
Not a single one of these people could hope to escape today.

It hadn’t been easy for him to catch a big fish like Wisdom King. He wouldn’t allow this fish to escape. If he wanted a bigger fish, he would need to start targeting the Daofuses. And that was too much for him to handle.
A Daofuse in the same situation would most likely be able to escape the Death Realm alive.
At the same time.
Up in the world of the living.
With the disappearance of Su Yu and the Invincibles, many people looked over curiously. What now? All those people had entered the Death Realm.
Suddenly, a certain minor realm shook. However, there were no crimson clouds or rain in the sky. After all, the death had happened in the Death Realm. Thus, only a minor phenomenon had appeared.

Nevertheless, someone who had affirmed their dao in their own realm was intimately linked to their realm. The death of someone like that would cause a reaction from the realm. Inside the realm, volcanoes were erupting, the ground was shaking, and the sky itself was splitting apart.
Anyone could see that the ruler of that realm had died. Numerous people were shocked by that implication. Dead?
Right at that moment, another minor realm shook as natural disasters erupted inside the realm and killed countless people.
Yet another death.
The same thing happened repeatedly.

The numerous experts watched on in shock. The Death Realm was indeed dangerous. Just what did they encounter down there? Death sovereigns? But with Wisdom King and more than ten Invincibles among them, they could survive even facing ten death sovereigns. What could do this to them?
Abruptly, a loud rumble rang out.
A gigantic staff dropped down from the sky.
A golden body was smashed apart, and an illusory figure could be seen shooting far away in panic.

The wielder of the staff, a gigantic ancient ape, gave chase while dragging the staff behind him. As he chased, he ordered, “Bountiful Treasure, kneel down and call me grandpa or I’ll not stop before killing you.”
Heavendoom had emerged victorious. After so many years, he had finally won another fight. He had smashed Bountiful Treasure General’s body apart.
Bountiful Treasure’s pitiful voice rang out, “That’s too much! How about this? I can buy my life with money! You can have the record character! I’ll buy my life with it!”
Bountiful Treasure did not stop fleeing even as he haggled. Heavendoom ignored the offer. He only wanted to beat Bountiful Treasure to death. Treasures? Characters? Why would he care?

He much preferred killing Bountiful Treasure. Bountiful Treasure had been feeling very confident after becoming a titled general. What was the big deal about that? Heavendoom himself wasn’t a titled general, but that was mostly due to his laziness or he would have been one long ago.
Just then, the old turtle’s voice rang out, “Bountiful Treasure, hand over the record character and Heavendoom will spare you.”
“Boss!”
“Just listen.”
Heavendoom was unhappy, but he did not argue further. He shouted, “Hand it over immediately or I’ll kill you!”
Far away, Bountiful Treasure hurriedly tossed an item over. Elsewhere, the Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor’s eyes flickered as he moved to snatch it, but he was stopped by a gigantic bamboo.
The Iron Devourer Pseudo Emperor had finally finished eating the dragon. He grinned and asked, “What are you doing?”
The Celestial Chasm Pseudo Emperor evaded the attack as his expression changed slightly.
With the same silly smile on his face, the Iron Devourer Pseudo Emperor said, “Just stay here or I’ll have to hit you.”

Somewhere else, Heavenly Overseer Marquis’ was looking over with blood seeping out of his mouth as well. When his gaze landed on the record character, he coughed another mouthful of blood and asked, “Are you accepting that thing to deal with me?”
The old turtle answered indifferently, “Not at all. It might be useful for Su Yu so I might as well accept it.”
The Heavenly Overseer Marquis smiled bitterly and said, “Brother Grand Dream, you are truly generous.”
The old turtle ignored that remark.
Far away, Heavendoom grabbed the character and suppressed its resistance instantly. It was only a character, a part of a weapon instead of an entire weapon. Thus, it could be easily dealt with.
When the character calmed down, Heavendoom put it away. Then, he lifted his staff and shot elsewhere. Damn that Bountiful Treasure for wasting his time.

At the Immortal Realm, Tiangu’s expression changed. Something had gone wrong. With Bountiful Treasure’s defeat, the balance would start to shift. Heavendoom was very strong. When he joined the other battles, he could create a chain reaction, ultimately resulting in even more victories on his side.
Tiangu looked at the Divine and Devil Realms.
Two clumps of flame ignited in his eyes.

The immortals had put a lot of effort into this. Six old fossils had been deployed on top of eight seventh-degree Eternals. A total of fourteen late-degree Eternals were involved. This was an unimaginable amount of effort.

Meanwhile, the divines and devils were still holding back. The number of late-degree Eternals they had deployed was far lower. They could have dealt with the thirty-five guardians much more easily otherwise. Even Bountiful Treasure had only joined the battle because of the immortals.

With Heavendoom free, they needed at least one or two ninth-degree Eternals to restore the balance. Were the immortals really supposed to take out more trump cards for this? Furthermore, something must have happened in the Death Realm. Wisdom King might be in trouble.
